subject.title: Feature: Cross-platform multi-select component in message tool

question: Should OpenClaw standardize a minimal portable batch-selection primitive despite unequal native channel UX?
rationale: The capability is absent from both current and released contracts, and choosing its result shape, fallback semantics, and relationship to channel-specific components is a durable public API decision rather than an implementation detail.

options.title: Add portable batch select
options.body: Define a typed selected-values result with min/max hints and explicit native, button, and text fallback behavior.

options.title: Add plugin extension seam first
options.body: Let plugins register new presentation controls and channel adapters before implementing multiselect outside core.

options.title: Keep channel-specific only
options.body: Retain scalar portable presentation and direct advanced selection workflows to Discord, Slack, or Telegram-specific APIs.

recommendation.title: Add portable batch select
recommendation.body: Define a typed selected-values result with min/max hints and explicit native, button, and text fallback behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest merged history on the public presentation contract and already provided the prior product-oriented issue review.
